description:
Create a custom transactional email template in Magento. 

1. Go to Marketing > Communications > Email Templates and create a new template.
2. Load the default 'New Order' template.
3. Name the new template 'NestWell Order Confirmation'.
4. Set the subject to: 'Your NestWell Home Order #{{var order.increment_id}} - Thank You!'.
5. In the template content, ensure the brand name 'NestWell Home' is present, add a support contact line containing 'support@nestwell-home.com', and keep the order ID variable '{{var order.increment_id}}'.
6. Save the template.
7. Go to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Sales Emails > Order and set the 'New Order Confirmation Template' to your new custom template.
8. Save the configuration.

If not logged in, use admin / Admin1234!.
